note: What a server sends to turn a unit to face a direction. The header names the unit acting.

fields.name: towardX
fields.note: The direction faced, along one ground axis.

fields.name: towardY
fields.note: The direction faced, in height.

fields.name: towardZ
fields.note: The direction faced, along the other ground axis.

revisions.note: Where towardX and towardZ are both zero, a client does not turn the unit at once, but it still keeps the zero direction as the one the unit is to face. What follows from that is not recorded.
